Trailer forms of both kinds and the equipment sections of the H2S daily are photo-based, so a defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside the images, not as text, and cannot be checked from the form data.

14 of 14 submissions read. Both job boards were available — the 11/22/2026 ArkLaTex and Permian Basin boards sent by Blake Walton at 10:05 AM Central — and 39 manned-block rows were checked for coverage, of which 17 are active customer assignments after excluding standby, days off, PTO, demobilizing and WTX support rows. This run started at 11:06 PM Central, before the Central day closed, so any forms submitted after that time are not in these counts; missing Trailer Readiness Forms are the finding most often resolved by a late submission, as is Allen White's night-shift daily at Lipsey 1H.
